items.title: Edom, in the day of his brother
items.charge: Standing on the other side when strangers carried Jacob away; rejoicing over Judah's fall; cutting off those that escaped

items.title: Esau
items.charge: Despising his birthright; marrying Hittite wives; purposing to kill his brother

items.title: Haman the Agagite
items.charge: Plotting the destruction of all the Jews; building a gallows for Mordecai

items.title: The Samaritan village, and the sons of thunder
items.charge: Refusing to receive him because his face was toward Jerusalem; James and John asking for fire from heaven
